title: The Flea Market
content: Anyone else experience a much more grounded, rural, realistic mall when it comes to the main mall? Mines more akin to an indoor flea market, rather than a futuristic mega plaza. It serves the same purpose as a whole city indoors, nothing we haven’t heard before, complete with odd stores, apartments, libraries, kids play places, food courts. I do experience visiting the more futuristic areas often replicated here, especially and namely the long highway headed into the giant metropolis, but not so much the mall.
